title: On the Tip of the Tongue: First-Token Cueing as a Behavioral Probe of Recall Failures in LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2610.23400v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models often answer factual questions incorrectly in closed-book settings, and such errors are usually attributed to missing knowledge. Yet models often encode answers they fail to produce. We show that many closed-book errors are first-token recall failures: the model commits to a wrong first token, but once given the right one it completes the answer and often recognizes it as correct. We study this with First-Token Cueing, a behavioral probe that prefills the response with the first token of the gold answer. Model uncertainty peaks at the first answer token, where it already predicts correctness, and among gold prefixes of any length the first token alone accounts for the largest share of recovered errors. Across 16 open models, this one token corrects between a fifth and a half of the errors on multi-token answers in English QA and improves accuracy in all seven languages of a multilingual benchmark. translated_title: 话到嘴边：首词提示作为大语言模型回忆失败的行为探针
translated_abstract: 大语言模型在闭卷设置下常常错误地回答事实性问题，这类错误通常被归因于知识的缺失。然而，模型往往已经编码了它们无法生成的答案。我们证明许多闭卷错误其实是首词回忆失败：模型错误地确定了答案的第一个词，但一旦给定正确的首词，它便能完成答案，并常常能识别出该答案是正确的。我们通过“首词提示”来研究这一现象，这是一种行为探针，通过在响应前预填充标准答案的首词来进行引导。模型的不确定性在答案首词处达到峰值，此时首词已能预测答案的正确性；并且在任意长度的标准答案前缀中，仅首词就能挽回最大比例的错误。在16个开源模型上，仅这一个词在英语问答中就能纠正多词答案上五分之一到二分之一的错误，并在多语言基准测试的全部七种语言中提升了准确率。大部分错误……
tldr: 研究发现大语言模型的许多闭卷错误实为“首词回忆失败”，提出的首词提示行为探针仅需预填充正确答案的首词，即可在16个开源模型上挽回五分之一到一半的多词答案错误，并提升七种语言的问答准确率。
en_tdlr: Many closed-book errors in LLMs are first-token recall failures, and a First-Token Cueing probe that prefills the gold answer's first token recovers one-fifth to half of multi-token errors across 16 models while improving accuracy in all seven languages of a multilingual benchmark.
